name: publicWeb_getEventTrailTypes
description: Returns the owning kennel's PackTrack trail-type config JSON (HC.Kennel.TrailTypesConfigJson) for a run, by the run's INTERNAL id. Called server-side by the GetPositions function, which bundles it into the position payload on the full fetch only, so trail-type labels resolve on app and web even when the viewer does not follow the kennel. Unauthenticated read; no PII (labels / emoji a kennel chose).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Internal HC.Event.id (the id PackTrack keys positions by), not PublicEventId. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

rowsets.name: ValidationError
rowsets.description: Only when the guard at line 30 fails (@eventId NULL or the empty GUID); outside the TRY, NOT logged to HC.ErrorLog; the SP returns.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Fixed text naming the missing parameter.

rowsets.name: TrailTypesConfig
rowsets.description: Single row; the value is NULL when the kennel has no customisation (clients fall back to built-in defaults). 0 rows when no HC.Event has this id (deleted / removed are not checked).

columns.name: trailTypesConfigJson
columns.description: Per-kennel merge-by-value trail-type config JSON (HC.Kennel.TrailTypesConfigJson), or NULL.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW in the CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: The CATCH (line 50) logs ErrorName 'Unhandled error in getEventTrailTypes' and HcVersion '<unknown>'; the validation refusal (lines 30-34) is not logged.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
